Thanks again for the time earlier, Samir — great conversation. As promised, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an initial stakeholder map for your team. High-level recap and proposed next steps: 

- Objective: Pilot Redwood Inference for FinPay's customer support AI (inference for triage + routing) with latency SLOs at 200ms p95 and strict data residency in us-east-1.
- Key decision criteria we heard: response latency, inference cost per 1k requests, SOC2 + encryption at rest, and procurement/contract flexibility.
- Suggested MAP milestones (draft attachments):
  1) NDA & security questionnaire returned (target: 2 weeks)
  2) Technical POC (2 weeks)
  3) Pilot roll-out (6 weeks)
  4) Pricing & commercial terms final (aligned with pilot results)

Action items for your side: please confirm the economic buyer and security/procurement owners (I sketched a map in the attachment). Also confirm target go/no-go date for the pilot so we can align capacity.

Attachments: MAP_FinPay_v1.xlsx (draft), procurement_timeline.xlsx (sample)

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute sync the week of Mar 23 to lock stakeholders and timeline. If that works, I can send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Marissa
